title: Lostpiece
description: Lost Piece is a One Piece inspired MMORPG Minecraft server with over 20+ Custom devilfruits and alot of unique Bosses
body:
# Set Sail for LostPiece ⚓
Lost Piece is a One Piece inspired MMORPG Minecraft server with over 20+ Custom devilfruits and Custom islands/bosses with rare items, Pirate crews, boats & ships you can sail with, and a great adventure

### 🌊 Explore Battle & Conquer The Seas
- **Custom Devil Fruits:** Discover unique powers that grant you incredible abilities—will you control the elements or transform into a beast?

- **Haki System:** Train your spirit to unleash Conqueror’s, Armament, and Observation Haki to dominate the battlefield.

- **Boss Battles:** Test your strength against world-class bosses and claim their legendary loot.

- **Bounty System:** Raise your bounty by Leveling up and getting Stronger to become one of the Strongest.

- **Build Your Crew:** Team up with friends to form a crew and raid Pirates & Dungeons together to get rare loot and become stronger

- **Player-Driven Economy:** Market place to sell your items for other players, trading to trade with other players and more.

- **Regular Updates:** Our team is constantly adding new islands, fruits, and features to keep the adventure fresh and the meta evolving.
